authoring_notice: Connection features are BrickForge-authored nominal stud-grid datums. They are not copied from BrickLink Studio or inferred from detailed clutch geometry.
limitations: A matched stud and receiver datum is only a candidate geometric interface.
This catalogue does not model clutch force, friction, interference tolerances, tube deformation, material behaviour, or long-term wear.
Only the standard rectangular brick and plate families listed in this catalogue are covered.
Do not infer connection compatibility for other part families from these profiles.

Geometric alignment does not prove clutch engagement, legal combination, or structural stability.
